messages:
Ana: Quick thread to align on a unified connector preview for Snowflake + Databricks Unity + Milvus. Goal: single ops runbook + short customer checklist.
Vik: Thanks. Two main asks: 1) reproducible CI for Delta Share -> vector index, 2) a short playbook for SI handoff.
Sophie: Marketing wants a 90s demo video and a one-pager. Can we promise a masked sample dataset by EOD Fri?
Marco: Infra note: Milvus optimized kv cache needs kernel flag set on Aurora nodes. Will check firmware and post matrix.
Ana: Proposed mini timeline: Day0 partner PMs & logos, Day2 sample dataset, Day4 CI pass, Day6 soak, Day8 dry-run & embargo.
Vik: Decision point: combined bundle vs certified connector badge. Ops prefers badge to avoid revenue-share delay.
Sophie: Agree badge. Faster to market. We'll draft co-branding that avoids performance claims.
PartnerOpsBot: Logo approval request sent to Snowflake and Milvus at 2026-03-10T12:05Z. Status: pending.
Marco: Infra action: run CI with Milvus 2.3 and Milvus 2.5, Unity Catalog sandbox, Delta Share consumer creds. ETA 48h after dataset.
InfraQA: CI job created: connectors/ci/delta-unity-milvus-matrix. Artifacts will upload on failure.
Ana: Can legal confirm EU residency and dataflow notes by Tue 18:00 UTC?
Sophie: I'll ping legal. Also prepping the demo storyboard.
Vik: I'll draft the SI enablement agenda: 60m webinar, quick start repo, troubleshooting cheatsheet. Will share slides in the doc.
Marco: Firmware note: Aurora nodes need fw >=1.12 for our batching kernels. Confirmed.
Ana: Owners: infra=Marco, marketing=Sophie, SI=Vik, legal=Sandra. I'll fold this into the triage doc and loop partner PMs after logo approvals.
Sophie: Adding rollback steps: unpublish listing, disable feature flag, emergency support channel.
Ana: Thanks all ":thumbsup:" Next sync Fri 09:00 PT if needed.
InfraQA: End of thread.
